normative_extracts.quote: The Navigation API provides a centralized navigate event with intercept() and an AbortSignal that aborts when a subsequent navigation supersedes the current one.

pipeline_phases: Radix Trie Segment Matching (Static > Param > Wildcard)
Parallel Nested Loader Execution with AbortSignal
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Radix tries resolve URL segments in O(path_length) without backtracking regexes, while AbortSignal cancels superseded loader fetches before committing History state.

production_failures.symptom: Stale page content renders after rapid back/forward clicks
production_failures.root_cause: Route loaders ignore the navigation AbortSignal, allowing an earlier slow response to commit after a newer navigation completed.
production_failures.mitigation: Forward the router's per-navigation AbortSignal into every fetch() inside route loaders and bail on AbortError.

production_failures.symptom: 400+ ms blank layout delay on nested routes
production_failures.root_cause: Fetching data inside component useEffect hooks instead of parallel route loaders creates sequential network waterfalls.
production_failures.mitigation: Hoist data dependencies to route-level loaders dispatched concurrently right after radix matching.
